texts.bulletin: Harvest disruption risk in Santa Praxedes due to rainfall of 23.6 mm/24h. Farmers in ripening or harvesting stages should: (1) Defer combine harvester deployment to avoid bogging; (2) Protect cut stalks from further wetting; (3) Prioritize mechanical drying over sun-drying for collected grain. Postharvest drying risk is ELEVATED. Coordinate with DA mechanization service providers for mobile dryer access.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Rain risk for harvest in Santa Praxedes. Defer harvest, use mechanical dryer if available. Call MAO for help.

HARVEST ADVISORY — Santa Praxedes
Rainfall of 23.6 mm may disrupt ongoing harvest operations.
Recommended actions:
1. Advise farmers to assess field conditions before deploying machinery.
2. Coordinate with RCEF mechanization pool for mobile dryer deployment.
3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.
